reviews.author: Kollya Moideen
reviews.text:
It’s me Haris
I had a really wonderful experience at KK Tamizha Dance Studio Dubai! 💃✨

I joined a dance practice session and really enjoyed it. Shivani was very friendly, supportive, and made the training easy and fun. The whole session was energetic, comfortable, and enjoyable.

The atmosphere at the studio is very positive and welcoming, and the instructors make you feel comfortable from the beginning. I had such a fun time and I’m definitely looking forward to joining more sessions.

Highly recommended for anyone who loves dancing and wants to learn in a friendly and enjoyable environment! ❤️
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much, Haris! ❤️ It was truly wonderful having you in our dance practice session. I’m so happy to hear that you enjoyed the session and felt comfortable throughout. Your positive energy and enthusiasm made the experience even more enjoyable!
Looking forward to seeing you again in our upcoming sessions. Keep dancing and keep shining! 🔥

reviews.author: Praveena K
reviews.text: I attended the dance workshop yesterday and it was a great experience, danced out my heart after a year, super refreshing. reviews.author: Jennifer Nathan
reviews.text: I’m Jennifer, The first dance session was a great experience. The instructor created a welcoming and comfortable environment, making it easy for beginners to follow along. The warm-up exercises were effective, and the basic dance steps were explained clearly and demonstrated well. The pace of the class was appropriate, allowing everyone to practice and build confidence. The session was engaging, energetic, and enjoyable, leaving participants motivated to learn more. Overall, it was a well-organized introduction to dance and a positive start to the course.

reviews.author: Selva
reviews.text:
It is a wonder that dance classes are held in this area too. A talented choreographer & Master. It is a place where everyone can learn dance in a simple and patient manner.  It is a suitable place for everyone. Dance lessons are offered here for both children and adults. All categories of dance are practiced here. The team with them is also very talented.

They teach everyone about dance in a wonderful way, and there is something great about it.

[D]ISCIPLINE + [A]TTITUDE + [N]ATURE RHYTHM + [C]REATIVITY + [E]MOTION AND ENERGY

They teach that *DANCE* is all of these things united.

I am also going to develop my skills with them. Those who are interested in dancing in this area are welcome to come and join us. Thank you.
